name: PHP
needs: PHP 7.4 or newer with the FFI extension enabled and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
notes: PHP's FFI declares functions with a C-syntax string (`FFI::cdef`). That string lives inside `peep.php`; there is no separate header file.
Run PHP with `-d ffi.enable=1` (or set `ffi.enable=1` in php.ini).
`read` returns at most 4096 frames per call.
files: decodes the test files and prints checksums
